svg.title: CPU cost to the machine per workload
svg.desc: harness process + every descendant (cpu_total_ms), median over n=5 trials per lane. Lower is better.
svg.text: CPU cost to the machine per workload
harness process + every descendant (cpu_total_ms), median over n=5 trials per lane. Lower is better.
Rows whose two intervals overlap (not REAL) are dimmed and flagged: they are not safe to act on. Fairness: the native lane runs the backend IN the harness,
so its CPU is the harness's own; the rclone lane's is the harness plus its rclone subprocess. Both bars are the sum - that is the comparable number.
